instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor conducting a reassessment. Analyse the prior assessment summary, changes since last assessment, and updated survey, then respond with a complete reassessment JSON including score_delta, carry_forward, progress, and comparison_to_previous.

answers.companyDescription: Life insurance and retirement savings provider managing €800M in mathematical provisions. Traditional with-profits and unit-linked products distributed through bancassurance partnerships with 3 retail banks. Exploring digital onboarding and needs-analysis tools for bank branch advisors. We are a bootstrapped company with a lean team. Every euro of investment must show near-immediate ROI given our constrained working capital. The founder is involved in all strategic decisions including innovation priorities.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources. Our current portfolio includes 4 active projects across new business models, digital products, and operational AI use cases. One incubated project has already graduated to become a standalone business unit.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist 3 years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models. We are open to both organic build initiatives and strategic acquisitions of small, innovative companies that can serve as diversification platforms.

fields.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

input.changes_since_last: Transitioning from founder-led to professional management. Hired 5 senior leaders. Strategic planning process being formalized.

opportunities.title: Develop Digital Distribution Channels for Insurance Products (B2B/Advisor Focus)
opportunities.rationale: The core business relies heavily on bancassurance, but the board demands diversification. Leveraging the existing digital onboarding explorations to build a dedicated portal or recommendation engine directly usable by bank advisors will scale reach and reduce reliance solely on physical branches.

first_actions: Map current advisor workflow against regulatory compliance requirements (compliance check).
Define MVP features for the digital advisory tool (e.g., needs-analysis questionnaire, product recommendation logic).
Pilot integration feasibility with one key bancassurance partner.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in advisor time spent on initial needs assessment by 30%
milestones: Interactive prototype completion and internal testing (Month 2)
Pilot launch with limited partner segment (Month 3)

opportunities.title: Implement AI-Driven Regulatory Compliance and Documentation Platform (RegTech)
opportunities.rationale: Given the high regulatory environment and complex product lines, manual compliance tracking poses a major operational risk. Implementing a centralized RegTech platform will automate policy change ingestion, process documentation, and ensure continuous audit readiness across all incubated units.

first_actions: Engage external regulatory counsel to define necessary data points for automation (compliance focus).
Audit existing internal policy documents and map them to required compliance checkpoints.
Select vendor/platform capable of handling complex financial regulations (e.g., GDPR, Solvency II related reporting).
Define integration points with core operational systems.
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduction in time spent generating quarterly regulatory reports by 50%
milestones: Compliance gap analysis and requirement definition (Month 1)
Pilot deployment on one internal unit's reporting cycle (Month 6)

next_steps.action: Formalize a 'Process Owner' role for each of the 4 active venture units to distribute functional knowledge away from the founder.
Establish a formal KPI framework linking successful project incubation (Venture Studio) directly to measurable revenue generation in the next 6 months.
Conduct a detailed operational deep dive into which adjacent markets (non-insurance) can be served by the existing bank distribution network, quantifying potential entry points for diversification.

key_weaknesses: High owner dependency remains a critical bottleneck despite hiring senior leadership (Decision-Making Gap).
Lack of standardized process documentation across the diverse portfolio of incubated units.
Operational scaling risk: The team is growing quickly, but formal cross-functional governance mechanisms are still maturing.

improvements: Formalized internal venture studio model with dedicated investment committee oversight (Process Maturity).
Improved digital maturity score from 3 to 4 through focused exploration of digital tools.
Strengthened governance by hiring five senior leaders and professionalizing strategic planning.
persistent_gaps: Translating successful innovation projects into repeatable, profitable commercial models (Commercialization Gap).
Systemic adoption of new compliance protocols across newly formed business units.
Balancing rapid diversification with the need for consistent, high-quality regulatory adherence.
achieved_milestones: Successful graduation of one incubated project into a standalone operational unit.
Formalization of quarterly pitching and vetting process within the venture studio.

comparison_to_previous.key_changes: Significant improvement in process maturity and team structure (formalized VC model, hired senior staff), raising confidence but highlighting the critical need to mitigate founder dependency risks.
